title: General Prosecutor of Italy's Highest Court Advocates the Decriminalization of Drugs.
description: The general prosecutor of Italy's highest court has created a storm after advocating the decriminalisation of drugs. content_html_sanitized:
The general prosecutor of Italy's highest court has created a storm after advocating the decriminalisation of drugs. Speaking at the inauguration of the judicial year last week, Ferdinando Zucconi Gallifonseca said that while users were imprisoned, dealers invariably escaped to enjoy a life on the beach.

The Italian government failed to respond to the debate last week, but the media have taken up the issue seriously, and thousands of people have written in support of his cause.
